cards.mood: The piece opens with a commanding, martial introduction that immediately establishes a tone of grandeur and solemnity.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male) and a Male Choir Ensemble.
cards.palette: A full symphonic brass section (trumpets, trombones, French horns) serves as the core melodic and harmonic driver, present from the opening fanfare through to the final cadence, delivering bold, heroic motifs.
